Package arztis.econnector.ihe.queries

Provides classes which are build and send ELGA requests
  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    AssertionTransactions
    This class contains all functionalities to request
    Identity assertion of SVC and ELGA ETS Health care provider (HCP) assertion of ELGA ETS Context assertion for electronic immunization state and virtual organization of ELGA ETS e-Card only assertion of SVC.
    GdaSearch
    This class contains all functionalities to request
    health care provider from GDA-Index.
    PatientContactTransactions
    This class contains all functionalities to
    confirm patient contact at ELGA KBS with e-Card and without e-Card
    Contact confirmations are a proof of a treatment contact between a health care provider and a patient.
    PatientIndexTransactions
    This class contains all functionalities to request
    patient demographic information from ZPI (central patient index) This class includes all needed transactions of IHE PDQ integration profile.
    PharmTransactions
    This class includes all needed transactions of IHE CMPD (Community Medication Prescription and Dispense) integration profile.
    ValidationTransactions
    This class contains all functionalities to validate a CDA document.
    XdsTransactions
    This class includes all needed transactions of IHE XDS (Cross-Enterprise Document sharing) and XCA (Cross-Community Access) integration profile.
